newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. stock index futures end sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. stock index futures end sharply lower.

text.p: May 7 - U.S. stock index futures ended down, with most posting sharp losses on profit-taking and T-bond weakness. June S&P 500 erased nearly all of Monday's run to record high. Traders deem late trade choppy, erratic. One chartist calls action "a down day within the context of the overall rally."
